summary: Builds four 4x4 transform matrices on the stack from parameters a2 (negated when positive), a3 (clamped to [0,1]) and a4 (used as a scalar power/twist base), passes their pointer table to sub_5677B0 to combine them, then writes the combined result as eight dwords into this[0..0x1C]. On failure (non-zero result from sub_5677B0) the output is zeroed except the last dword set to the identity value 1072693248 (1.0f). Stores input parameter a4 into this[4] (field 0x20) as a double.

local_names.a4: twist/power scalar base (stored at this[4] and raised to powers)
local_names.v15..v40: stack-resident matrix and coefficient storage (mixed int/double)
local_names.v42: pointer table of the four matrix slots passed to sub_5677B0

operations.description: If a2 > 0.0, negate it so a2 is always <= 0.0 (comparison against zero sentinel dbl_59E430).
Clamp a3 into [0,1]: a3 >= 1.0 becomes 1.0, a3 < 0.0 becomes 0.0, otherwise unchanged (bounds from globals dbl_59E420=1.0 and dbl_59E430=0.0).
Store input parameter a4 as a double into this[4] (field this+0x20).
Fill the v42 pointer table with the addresses of four consecutive 40-byte matrix slots in the v15 stack buffer (v7 advances by 10 dwords per iteration, 4 iterations).
Compute coefficient powers and initialize the four matrix slots: a4*a4, a4*a4*a4, 3*a4*a4, a4+a4, plus identity (1072693248 = 1.0f) and zero entries; constant 3.0 sourced from global dbl_59E7E0.
Call sub_5677B0 with the matrix pointer table v42 and count 4 to combine the four matrices; the non-zero return marks failure.
On failure (sub_5677B0 returned non-zero): zero all eight output dwords this[0x0..0x18] and set this[0x1C] to identity value 1072693248 (1.0f).
On success: copy the combined matrix dwords from the stack locals into this[0x0..0x1C] (eight dwords).
Return the result of sub_5677B0 (0 success, non-zero failure).

clean_pseudocode: init matrices from a4 powers (a4^2, a4^3, 3*a4^2, 2*a4) and identity entries;
else copy combined matrix into this[0..7];
